## What it is

The record of one periodic review of a system's accounts and privileges, with a decision for every account, the actions taken and the sign-off, and a register of every review, as SP 800-53 AC-2j and AC-6(7) require.

## Controls satisfied

| Control | Title |
| --- | --- |
| [AC-2](/controls/ac/ac-2/) | Account Management |
| [AC-2(3)](/controls/ac/ac-2/#ac-2.3) | Disable Accounts |
| [AC-5](/controls/ac/ac-5/) | Separation of Duties |
| [AC-6(7)](/controls/ac/ac-6/#ac-6.7) | Review of User Privileges |

## Preview (annotated)

:::note[Guidance]
Use one record for each review of a system. Section 5.8 of the [account management procedure](/templates/procedures/account-management-procedure/) is the process; this record is its evidence. Assessors ask for the last review and look for four things: the account list was complete, including service, emergency and application-local accounts; every account has a decision; accounts the review flagged were actually disabled or removed, with dates; and the reviewer is someone who knows whether each person still needs the access. A review in which no account is ever removed is a common finding, and so is a list exported only from the identity provider when the application keeps its own accounts. An identity governance tool can run the review and keep these fields; export its report and attach it here. The register at the end is also downloadable as a CSV file.
:::

### 1. Scope and frequency

- The <span class="tpl-field tpl-org">System owner</span> reviews all accounts on the system <span class="tpl-field tpl-param">Fill in: the frequency of account review <span class="tpl-typical">Typical: quarterly for privileged accounts and at least annually for all other accounts</span></span> for compliance with the Access Control Policy and the account management procedure (AC-2j).
- The <span class="tpl-field tpl-org">System owner</span> reviews the privileges assigned to <span class="tpl-field tpl-param">Fill in: roles or classes of users to which privileges are assigned <span class="tpl-typical">Typical: all roles and classes of users on the system</span></span>, <span class="tpl-field tpl-param">Fill in: the frequency at which to review the privileges assigned to roles or classes of users <span class="tpl-typical">Typical: quarterly for privileged roles and at least annually for all other roles</span></span>, to validate the need for them (AC-6(7)(a)).
- The <span class="tpl-field tpl-org">Account manager</span> disables or removes the accounts, and reassigns or removes the privileges, that the review finds are not needed (AC-2j, AC-6(7)(b)).

### 2. Account list

| --- | --- |
| Sources of the account list | <span class="tpl-field tpl-fill">Fill in: for example the identity provider, the application's own user table, the database, the cloud console</span> |

### 3. Account decisions

Every account on the list gets a row. Supervisors confirm the need for their users' access; the <span class="tpl-field tpl-org">System owner</span> decides.

| Accounts whose roles do not match an approved access request | <span class="tpl-field tpl-fill">Fill in: number found, and actions</span> |
